The speaker's breathiness increases as if performing heavy physical activity, yet the articulation remains clear. The background music maintains its energetic tempo without interruption. (3) The speaker transitions to listing promotional details including specific numbers and dates. His voice maintains a high arousal level with frequent upward pitch inflections to emphasize the 'cheap price.' The rustling of a plastic pouch is briefly audible during a vocal pause. (4) The audio sequence concludes with an exaggerated, comedic plea. The speaker's tone becomes more desperate and melodramatic, while the electronic beat stays driving and upbeat. A final sharp intake of breath is recorded just before the track cuts out.
